messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — proposing a soft-pin of runtime 3.2.1 for EU hosted cluster during the 02:00-04:00 UTC change window tomorrow. Main reason: small perf regression observed with quantized llama3q on latest serving kernels.

sam: ok, soft-pin meaning we keep 3.2.0 as default but route traffic to 3.2.1 only for canaries? :+1:

maya: correct. Canary traffic to 3.2.1, all else stays on 3.2.0. Want to make sure SDK v2.8 and v2.7 both behave — there are a few protocol tweaks in v2.8 that could surface as errors if runtime forces new protobuf.

li: noted. I've got an integration test matrix running across sdk 2.7/2.8 + runtime 3.2.0/3.2.1. Will share failures shortly.

deploy-bot: deploy plan created: soft-pin-runtime-3.2.1-eu | window: 2024-06-15T02:00Z-04:00Z | canary: 1% -> 10% @15m | rollout: manual approval required.

oliver: Are there specific API surface diffs or just internal kernel changes? If API-compatible, we can avoid re-releasing SDK.

maya: mostly internal. But there was a small change in the streaming chunk header that SDK v2.7 tolerates; v2.8 adds stricter validation which is why I want compatibility checks.

qa-jen: li's tests show a transient streaming parse error under heavy concurrency for sdk v2.8 + runtime 3.2.1 canary. Repro script: `for i in seq 1 200; do curl -N ...; done` — parsing fails ~3% of runs.

li: here's the failing log snippet: ```error: unexpected chunk header "\u0000" while parsing stream frame```

sam: hmm. Could be a kernel IO reorder on the new runtime. Is there an easy mitigation? fallback to non-streaming path for v2.8 canary?

maya: mitigation options: 1) delay soft-pin until we root cause; 2) soft-pin but exclude SDK v2.8 users from the canary via deploy routing rule; 3) patch runtime to be more lenient.

oliver: (2) seems lower risk. Do we have telemetry to identify SDK versions in requests?

deploy-bot: telemetry note: header `x-sdk-version` present in ~62% of traffic from EU; the remainder are older clients or server-side integrations.

li: we can add a routing rule to exclude `x-sdk-version: 2.8.*` from canary. I can prepare the route predicate in ~30m.

qa-jen: if we exclude 2.8, we should also add a regression alert specifically for v2.8 -> runtime 3.2.1 so we don't miss it post-rollout.

maya: agreed. Plan proposal: proceed with soft-pin tomorrow but with predicate that excludes SDK v2.8. Meanwhile li+oliver will triage the streaming parse with a short-term runtime patch candidate. If fix ready within 48h, we retry canary including v2.8.

sam: +1 from me. We should also update the release notes and the runtime pinlist so ops knows the ephemeral exception.

oliver: I'll draft a minimal runtime patch (lenient parse fallback) but it's best-effort. If we can't reproduce reliably we may need to instrument more tracing.

deploy-bot: requested approvals: @ops (for routing exception), @security (no change to auth), @product (impact notice).

opsbot: routing exception approved pending a rollback runbook. Please attach rollback steps before deploy.

maya: rollback runbook: 1) revert pinset to 3.2.0 default via deploybot command `deploybot set-default-runtime eu 3.2.0` 2) scale canary back to 0% 3) flush kvcache on the canary pool if streaming errors persist 4) contact oncall if >0.5% error rate persists for 10m.

li: added instrumentation to canary to capture raw stream frames for failed requests. Will rotate logs to secure storage.

qa-jen: I'll add an automated regression alert: alert if streaming parse errors >0.2% for SDK 2.8 in EU after any change.

maya: final checklist before window: - routing predicate for sdk exclusion (li) - rollback runbook added to ticket (maya) - release notes + pinlist update (sam) - tracing instrumentation (li) - qa alert (qa-jen)

sam: I'll push the pinlist update to the ops docs and ping #release-notes when done.

li: predicate ready and tested in staging. Will open the PR to deploybot rules now.

deploy-bot: PR created: github.com/redwood/deploy-rules/pull/482 — contains predicate `not header('x-sdk-version').matches('^2\\.8\\.')` and tests.

oliver: re: communication — let's add a short note to customers in EU who we detect on 2.8, saying we excluded them for canary and are working on a fix. Small ops email should be fine.

maya: agree. I'll draft message and route via Customer Success.

sam: approve to proceed with soft-pin under those constraints. :rocket:

deploy-bot: deploy window scheduled. Will start canary at 2024-06-15T02:10Z. Manual approval required at 02:30Z to expand to 10%.

qa-jen: post-deploy quick checks: verify streaming error rate for sdk 2.7/2.8 cohorts; check latency p50/p95; confirm no auth regressions.

maya: thanks team — looping back after the canary starts.

li: will monitor and post logs.

oliver: thanks — happy path looks straightforward with the exclusion.

deploy-bot: canary started at 2024-06-15T02:10Z | payload: 1% traffic | excluded sdk 2.8.

qa-jen: initial 15m: streaming parse errors for included cohorts ~0.05% — within baseline. No regression so far.

maya: holding for 02:30 manual approval to go to 10%. Will wait for li and qa thumbs-up.

li: thumbs-up from staging + prod small-sample logs look ok.

qa-jen: +1 from QA. Stagger to 5% first? safer.
